title: Playboys Playmate Review Eighth Annual Special Edition Magazine
conditionDescription: Pre-owned issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; possible cover wear, creases and edge/corner wear. Please review the photo for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Playboy's Playmate Review, Eighth Annual. Cover price $5.95. Newsstand code 38590 13.
A 112-page roundup of the past year's Playmates.

A Playboy special edition / newsstand special, not the monthly magazine. Playboy special editions are not dated on the cover; the newsstand code is given above to identify the exact issue.

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage.
